answer_2.quote: Following prior literature, we use the following three automated metrics: • Log-odds (LO) score ... • Comprehensiveness (Comp) score ... • Sufficiency (Suff) score ... Additionally, we use our proposed word-approximation error (WAE) metric ...

answer_4.quote: To further understand the impact of our algorithm on end users, we conduct human evaluations of explanations from our method and the two top baselines ... Finally, we show the highlighted sentence and the model's predicted label to the annotators and ask them to rank the explanations on a scale of 1-3, '1' being the most comprehensive explanation that best justifies the prediction.
answer_4.guideline: Rank explanations on a scale of 1-3 (1 being best) based on how comprehensively they justify the model's prediction.
